problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-2x+y+z=-1 \\ z+3x-2y=3 \\ -y+2z-x=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 & 1 \\ 3 & b & 1 \\ -1 & -1 & c\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}a \\ 3 \\ -4\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$

examples.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-y+z=4 \\ z-x+2=-1 \\ 2y-2x-4z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/0d06481c63a618262b9034124c24cd1d0c566ee9d6b891fa470e09dc67f5f6c6.png)
What are the values of $a,$ $b$ and $c?$
examples.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation in the correct order and all constants are on the right-hand side of the system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x-y+z=4 \\ -x+0y+z=-3 \\ -2x+2y-4z=-4\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b},$ where

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/104c591a6a72cf3caab1bc2a965c57258bb37a31578254696e0c1cd740fe5915.png)

is the coefficient matrix,

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/e008383384401198e67f648cce33a720d98afb6a6f60a14ba7ffa21dcc095a5f.png)

is the column vector of constants, and

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/c85e33202a691b685431ac16efab6a7fd932eac056743df6e81632587f0465b2.png)

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$ becomes

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14052721/assets/64d1f57717dda57c8a7fbc403728ee9699a22ce995f68a50a0b80f25543fdab6.png)

Therefore $a=0,$ $b=-2,$ $c=-3.$

feedback.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x-2y+4z=6 \\ 0x+y-9z=-2 \\ x-y-8z=1\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -9 \\ 1 & -1 & -8\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -9 \\ 1 & -1 & -8\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$
